_doc: Which open-weight model plays which role when OTARI_API_KEY is set (verdict_desk/llm.py). Every id is a catalog id of the hosted Otari gateway, so Otari picks the provider and falls back across offerings of the same model. Checked against the public catalog (GET /api/v1/catalog/models) by tools/otari_catalog_check.py: each id must exist and be open_weights.
_policies_doc: Routing policies created once in the Otari dashboard, one per role that needs a fallback chain of our own. Used as the `model` of that role only when use_policies is true (or OTARI_USE_POLICIES=1); OTARI_POLICY_<ROLE> names one for a single role, for a drill. Without them the catalog id keeps Otari's automatic fallback across offerings of the same model.
_cycle_doc: The app's own spend cap for one decision cycle, in USD: the sum of usage.cost_usd of the cycle's calls. Once reached, no further call is sent and each refused role leaves a client-side refusal receipt (code cycle_cap_exceeded). Otari's budgets are the first line, this is the second. OTARI_CYCLE_CAP_USD overrides.
_send_user_doc: false until the key is a service key: with an ordinary key Otari answers 403 "'user' field does not match the authenticated API key's user". Set true (or OTARI_SEND_USER=1) to send the role name as the `user` field, which is what per-user budgets bill.
